column1: # Phase 13, tail -- everything a full sweep of the repo still finds in Spanish,
# once the files themselves had moved. Mostly names the per-area maps missed
# because they were spelled with a word those maps did not carry.
# `sin_criba` / `sin_extra` (argparse dests, tied to Spanish flags), and the
# `del_paquete` carries `str`: it is a key of a dict built and read inside
# utils/extract_definitions.py, so the key moves with the code. `opciones_no_end`
# carries `code`: it is a field of the autopsy JSON, which is output data.
